decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Chuck, torque collar with readable detent numbers, trigger, belt clip and battery pack are all modelled, not textured on. Wireframe shows dense but even triangulation around the grip. The yellow plastic and black rubber read as distinct materials in every orbit view.
limitations: Battery label reads 18V 1.3Ah LITHIUM-ION, a generic specification with no manufacturer mark.
Chuck and trigger are static; no rig is included.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Glazed stoneware with a distinct crazed lid glaze; the top view shows the lid knob and rim concentric, and the bottom view shows a correctly darkened unglazed foot. Both lug handles are modelled through-holes, not decals. Wireframe is clean and evenly distributed.
limitations: Lid is a separate object already seated in place.
Glaze colour shifts noticeably under coloured lighting because the base is quite desaturated.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. The knotted rhizome silhouette is genuinely irregular and stays interesting from every orbit angle, with cut faces at the branch joints visible in the bottom and top views. Skin texture is photographic and free of stretching in the crevices. Wireframe shows a clean, evenly sized triangulation with no collapsed faces.
limitations: Pale, washed-out skin tone typical of young ginger; will read almost white in bright scenes.
Single fixed shape; no variants included.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Fuzzy skin reads convincingly with fine fibre detail that survives the orbit, and the top and bottom views show correctly differentiated stem and blossom ends rather than a mirrored sphere. Wireframe shows a clean, evenly distributed triangulation over the ovoid.
limitations: Whole fruit only; no sliced variant showing the green interior.
Fuzz is a texture effect, so it will not silhouette against a bright background.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. Carved tracery on the upper doors is real geometry, visible in the raking orbit views, and the four doors are separate objects shown slightly ajar. Back and bottom views confirm the carcass is properly closed with an unfinished ply back, which is correct for an antique. 12.2k tris.
limitations: Back panel uses a deliberately plain plywood texture, so do not place it facing camera.
Doors are modelled ajar; closing them means rotating the door objects.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views plus a full-size right orbit to check the drawer pulls. Twin pedestal carcass with six drawers, each with a separately modelled metal pull, and a closed modesty panel confirmed in the back view. The 4 is for materials: the grey steel is quite flat and uniform with little edge wear, so it reads cleaner than a used desk should.
limitations: Metal surfaces are uniformly clean with minimal wear or roughness variation.
Drawers are closed and not rigged to open.
